A forward-model property, not a derivative's

JAX 0.12's cond partial evaluation merges residual buffers of equal type across branches (lax.control_flow.conditionals._merge_branch_residuals): a cond's residuals are the largest branch's, kept whichever branch runs

operating_point.scene: the in-loop camera's ballistic case (probe/r1_core.py:case): a 20 um steel ball moving along a 60 um bore tube (wall 10 um, absorbing 3000 per m), seen across it from 1 mm by a camera fixed in the world, fx = fy = 750 px at 160 wide scaled with the width, no distortion; the base step 1 ms
operating_point.objective: J = sum over the steps of |c - p|^2 (pixels squared): c the darkness-weighted centroid of the camera's expected counts after the step (dark = 1 - expected / backlight, the tube's faint walls weighing in), p the ball's centre projected at the run's own leaves
operating_point.parameters: v0x (the ball's starting speed along the tube) and z0 (its starting height): they move a silhouette; fy, cy, k1: the detector's leaves
operating_point.platform: CPU, GitHub runner (4 vCPU, 16 GB), JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu
operating_point.sizes_and_parameters: correctness at 160x120 (draws and the fixed point) and 320x240 (the fixed point), 12 steps, frame period 2 to 4 (draws) or 3; costs at 320x240 and 640x480, 10, 100 and 1000 steps, a frame every step (period 1) and every 10th at one point
operating_point.seeds_and_draws: per seed: x0 uniform in [-45, 0] um, |z0| uniform in [8, 30] um either sign (the ball inside the lumen, off its axis so the vertical centroid is not degenerate), speed uniform in [0.5, 3] mm/s, period 2, 3 or 4

gate_1_reverse_against_forward.claim: the run-level scalar's gradient by vjp equals its gradient by jvp to the rounding of the chain, in both dtypes, at every draw

prediction.value: every draw and both fixed points pass; |vjp - jvp| at most 4 eps S
prediction.basis: derived (the same program's derivative in two orders), fitted at the 160 fixed point
prediction.why: reverse and forward mode multiply the same local Jacobians in opposite orders and sum the same terms in other trees; nothing branches differently because the cond's predicates are residuals

gate_1_reverse_against_forward.metric: |vjp - jvp| / (eps S), S the sum of the absolute contributions of every pixel and projected centre (the scale the result came from)

control.plant: edge-stop, cache-stop and held-stop (gate 7) leave T1 passing (they cut the derivative in both modes alike): T1 is not a control of the cut paths; T2 is

gate_1_reverse_against_forward.if_wrong: a mode-dependent derivative (a custom rule in one mode only, a cond whose transpose takes another branch): read the failing parameter's per-step rows
gate_1_reverse_against_forward.cannot_discriminate_if: a path is cut in both modes: T1 then passes; that is why T2 and the controls exist

gate_2_against_central_differences.claim: the reverse-mode gradient agrees with central differences within a bound derived from the ladder (truncation, the box edge's piecewise second derivative, J's rounding), in both dtypes, in all five parameters
gate_2_against_central_differences.case: probe/r1_grad.py ladder of 8 steps sqrt(10) apart (0.1 to 3e-5 of a pixel of image motion), r1_judge.py T2

prediction.value: pass at every draw and both fixed points; the float64 bound 1e-6 relative or tighter, the float32 bound 0.2 to 5 % (J's float32 rounding is about 3e-6 of J, over a step of a tenth of a pixel)
prediction.basis: derived, fitted at the 160 fixed point
prediction.why: the coverage (exact disc, box edge) is C1 in the edge's offset, so central differences converge, at worst as h where a pixel's kink is inside the step

control.plant: edge-stop (stop_gradient on the ball's exact disc coverage), cache-stop (stop_gradient on the held cache's path), held-stop (stop_gradient on a held frame)
control.resolution: the float32 bound, 0.2 to 5 % of the gradient; each plant removes a path worth 10 to 100 % of some parameter's gradient (cache-stop's share is the tube's weight in the centroid, about a third, in cy's derivative; the ball off the axis keeps it from vanishing)

gate_2_against_central_differences.if_wrong: a missed control: the plant's effect is under the float32 bound on that draw; a clean flag: the bound misses a mechanism (a non-C1 piece) - read the ladder
gate_2_against_central_differences.cannot_discriminate_if: both AD and CD are zero in a parameter, or the plant's path carries none of J's derivative on a draw (z0 near 0 for cache-stop)

gate_3_checkpointed_render.claim: with the render inside the cond under jax.checkpoint the gradient equals the unchecked one to rounding
gate_3_checkpointed_render.case: r1_grad.py with MIME_SPIKE_RENDER_CHECKPOINT=1 against without, the fixed points, r1_judge.py T3

prediction.value: within 4 eps S in both dtypes; bit for bit in float64: a guess, no (the recomputation is compiled in another fusion order)
prediction.why: jax.checkpoint recomputes the same primal operations in the backward pass; only XLA's fusion and so the rounding can differ

control.plant: none of its own: the checkpointed run also answers T2 against the same ladder, so a checkpoint that dropped a path fails T2

gate_3_checkpointed_render.if_wrong: a checkpoint that changes the program's value (a non-deterministic op, a random key inside the render): the key is folded from the step count, deterministic

gate_4_held_frames.claim: a parameter's effect on a frame reaches every later held step's reading: each held step's centroid derivative (reverse) equals its frame step's, and the ball's speed's derivative at each held step matches its own central difference
gate_4_held_frames.case: r1_grad.py --per-step (jacrev and jvp of each step's centroid), r1_judge.py H1, H2

prediction.value: float64 bit for bit; float32 within 128 eps of the parameter's largest; every held step's derivative nonzero and within its CD bound
prediction.basis: derived, fitted at the 160 fixed point
prediction.why: on a held step the cond's keep branch is the identity on expected, so the cotangent passes unchanged to the frame step; the frame step's cotangent then enters the same render

gate_4_held_frames.metric: max over held steps of the gap to the frame step's derivative

control.plant: held-stop (stop_gradient on the held frame in the keep branch)

gate_4_held_frames.if_wrong: a held step reading a different frame than it shows (the clock off by one), or the hold cutting the derivative
gate_4_held_frames.cannot_discriminate_if: period 1 (no held step): the draws' periods are 2 to 4

gate_5_cache_remake_from_the_start.claim: from the run's start (the cache made at step 0 from the step's own leaves) the leaves' derivative passes through the held cache to every frame; nothing of the moving ball reaches the cache (its tangent in v0x and z0 is exactly zero)
gate_5_cache_remake_from_the_start.case: T2 in fy, cy, k1 with and without cache-stop; r1_judge.py H4

prediction.value: the cache path carries 20 to 80 % of cy's derivative and 5 to 50 % of fy's and k1's (the tube's darkness is a third of the frame's in the centroid); H4 exactly zero
prediction.basis: derived from the centroid's weights (ball 700 to 2800 dark pixels, tube 600 to 1400)
prediction.why: the cache is made inside the differentiated run at step 0 and carried in the state; a held step's cotangent on it flows back to step 0's make

gate_5_cache_remake_from_the_start.metric: 1 - g(cache-stop) / g, per leaf, from the controls' JSON
gate_5_cache_remake_from_the_start.if_wrong: the cache made outside the differentiated program (a constant) would give the cache-stop gradient unplanted: T2 fails clean

gate_6_continued_run.claim: from a continued state (the cache made in an earlier run and its numbers equal) the derivative in the leaves misses the cache's part: the cond takes the held branch, whose state is a constant of the run, while any nudged leaf remakes it. Not a reverse-mode defect: forward mode does the same
gate_6_continued_run.case: r1_grad.py --continued 6 at the 160 fixed point, both dtypes, T2

prediction.value: T2 FAILS in fy, cy and k1 (AD short of CD by the cache's share, 20 to 80 % in cy) and passes in v0x and z0, in both dtypes; T1 passes (both modes miss it alike)
prediction.why: cache_from equals the step's numbers at the unperturbed leaves, so no remake; a perturbed leaf differs and remakes

control.plant: the run from the start (gate 5) is the arm that passes

gate_6_continued_run.if_wrong: if T2 passes: the derivative does flow (a remake under every trace, or the comparison traced differently); read cache_tangent
gate_6_continued_run.cannot_discriminate_if: a leaf the tube's image does not depend on (fx: the tube is uniform along u)

gate_7_controls.claim: each planted control fails every run on drawn operating points; the clean runs are quiet
gate_7_controls.case: .github/probe/detection_rate.py --script probe/r1_check.py, 6 arms x 5 planted runs (and 2 clean) per plant

prediction.basis: derived (edge-stop removes the silhouette's whole derivative in v0x and z0; held-stop zeroes every held step's derivative, caught by H1; cache-stop removes the tube's third of cy's)

gate_7_controls.if_wrong: a miss names its seed; the plant's size against T2's bound on that draw is read from the JSON

gate_8_costs.claim: reverse mode's peak memory and time per step through the real node (node_measure.py, MIME's differentiated run, the sum of the final state's floating fields, in fy), with and without the render checkpointed, with and without MIME's chunked run checkpoint, at 320x240 and 640x480, 10, 100 and 1000 steps, a frame every step; forward the same

prediction.mechanism: a cond's residuals are its largest branch's, kept at EVERY step whichever branch runs, and the frame's render nests the cache's remake (the ray table's undistortion, the tube's static part with its 16 corner sub-samples) under another cond, so every step keeps the residuals of a remake plus a render: R full frames a step, R about 60 to 200 (a guess within that band). Checkpointing the render keeps its inputs instead: the held cache (11 frames) and the state's frames, about 12 a step. MIME's chunked run keeps sqrt(N) chunk starts (the state, 13 frames) and one chunk's steps' residuals
prediction.forward_peak_gib: under 1.2 at every point (the state, 13 frames, and the frame's temporaries)
prediction.period_10_against_period_1: the same reverse memory within 15 % at 320 x 100 (every step keeps the render's residuals); reverse time per step about 4 to 8 times lower
prediction.float32: memory about half of float64's at the same point, time 0.5 to 0.8 of it
prediction.basis: derived from frame counts and the PR's forward times; the residual count R is a guess within its band

gate_8_costs.metric: peak resident set of the reverse phase (node_measure.py's reverse_peak_mib) and reverse_steady seconds per step

control.plant: the estimator's own check: each arm's peak against its mem_estimate.py bound (an underestimate fails the arm)

gate_8_costs.if_wrong: R far outside 60 to 200 frames: count the reverse program's residuals by aval (jaxpr) before reading a mechanism into it
gate_8_costs.cannot_discriminate_if: an arm's peak is the build's or the compile's, not the run's (read the phases)

gate_9_switch_scan_report.claim: report only: does the switch scan's rule hold for the camera's reverse program

prediction.value: the scan traces the forward step only (make_jaxpr of the node's step), so it says nothing about the reverse program directly. With the render checkpointed inside the cond the traced step gains a checkpoint around raw sites only: no switch function sits there, so no new hit, and the raw-switch list stands (tests/saved/test_switch_scan.py passes with the flag on). The listed reasons that rest on derivatives (round and the flags carry none; the frame cond chooses which value is kept) hold in reverse, where the cond's transpose takes the forward's branch. One listed reason is stale: the camera node's lines cite 'the cache's guard and its custom rule', a custom_jvp the merge's fix removed
prediction.basis: derived from mime.docs._switches and the node's history

gate_9_switch_scan_report.if_wrong: a hit under checkpoint: a switch function reached inside the render

gate_10_batching_R3.claim: only if 1 to 4 are done: under vmap the frame cond is a select, both branches every step

prediction.value: forward: every batched step renders B frames (held steps included): about B times a frame step's cost every step, B = 4 and 16 at 320x240; reverse: memory as the unbatched reverse times B (the residuals were kept every step already), time B times a frame step's reverse at every step; so camera.batched lifts cheaply only at period 1; at period P it costs P times the unbatched-in-sequence work, and needs Ask 52 or a batch by lax.map

gate_10_batching_R3.if_wrong: XLA keeping the cond under vmap where the predicate is unbatched (the frame clock is the same for every member): then held steps stay cheap, and the refusal can lift without Ask 52
